levels.instruction: Drag the biological terms to the correct computer concept.

levels.title: Level 2: The Vibe Score
levels.description: Tune the weights and bias to decide: Should I go to class?
levels.instruction: Adjust weights and bias to see how they affect the decision. Try to get a high Vibe Score!
levels.codeSnippet:
# Perceptron Calculation
z = (w1*x1) + (w2*x2) + (w3*x3) + b

# Activation Function (Sigmoid)
output = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-z))

levels.title: Level 3: The Mountain Descent
levels.description: Minimize the error by descending the Loss Mountain.
levels.instruction: Click 'Train' to update weights and slide down the error curve.
levels.codeSnippet:
# Gradient Descent Step
loss = (y_pred - y_true)**2
gradient = 2 * (y_pred - y_true) * input
weight = weight - (learning_rate * gradient)

levels.title: Level 4: The Pizza Factory
levels.description: Deep Learning: From Ingredients to Pizza.
levels.instruction: Hover over the layers to see how features are transformed.
levels.codeSnippet:
# Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)
model = tf.keras.Sequential([
  tf.keras.layers.Dense(4, activation='relu'), # Hidden Layer
  tf.keras.layers.Dense(1, activation='sigmoid') # Output Layer
])
